card.persona: Kevin Walsh, an existing patient born January 23, 1986, calling to book his own appointment.
card.goal: To book an annual physical with Dr. Reed on a Monday morning, insisting on that time despite no availability, and accepting a tentative booking with a promise from the front desk to ensure the time works.
card.style: Polite but firm, clearly stating preferences and repeating them when not initially met.

answers.question: Thank you for calling Linden Grove Family Practice, this is the automated scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
answers.answer: I need to book my annual physical with Dr. Reed, please. It has to be on a Monday morning, that's the only time I can make it.

answers.question: I can help with that. Could you please provide the name and date of birth of the patient needing the annual physical appointment?
answers.answer: My name is Kevin Walsh, spelled K-E-V-I-N W-A-L-S-H. My date of birth is January 23rd, 1986.

answers.question: Is the name I have, Kevin Walsh, correct?
I have a couple of openings with Dr. Reed on Tuesday, October 27th. We could fit you in at either 9 AM or 9:30 AM. Which time works for you?
